# Aftermarket radio installation with factory amp

## Summary

[Partial] Connect the new head unit's power wires to the vehicle harness and plug RCA pre-amp outputs into factory amplifier inputs. [t582]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Connect the new head unit's power wires to the vehicle harness.
2. [Partial] Plug in the RCA pre-amp outputs from the radio into the factory amplifier inputs.

## Parts

- Harmony Audio HA-707551 [t582]
- [Partial] Metra 70-7551, alternative [t582]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use RCA connections if keeping the existing factory amp to avoid distortion. [t582]
- Using speaker-level outputs directly on an amp can cause amplified signals and wasted alternator output. [t582]

## Common mistakes

- Installing a non-RF specific harness onto an RF system, resulting in distorted audio from sending speaker-level signals to an amp expecting line-level inputs. [t582]
